Flag activity in the 11PM-5AM window for review.

Surface first-time / low-history vendors for third-party due diligence.
Detect repeated charges to the same vendor for a similar amount within 48h.
Flag transactions exceeding normal spend for their category (>2.5σ).
Verify spend over approval thresholds carries the required authorization.
